desktop_verification.helper_source:
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import platform
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile

workspace = Path('/Users/le-evanmcpheron/Documents/Godot')
game = workspace / 'briarwake'
evidence_directory = workspace / 'mmo_docs/validation/tickets/BW-001-T02'
evidence_path = evidence_directory / 'desktop-runs.json'
project = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='bw001-t02-desktop-')) / 'briarwake'
shutil.copytree(game, project, ignore=shutil.ignore_patterns('.git', '.godot', '__pycache__'))
manifest = json.loads((evidence_directory / 'verification.json').read_text())['game_file_sha256']
run = {
    'started_at': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
    'source_project': str(game),
    'tested_project': str(project),
    'cache_absent_before_launch': not (project / '.godot').exists(),
    'game_revision': subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], cwd=game, text=True).strip(),
    'game_file_sha256': {file: hashlib.sha256((project / file).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for file in manifest},
    'macos': subprocess.check_output(['/usr/bin/sw_vers'], text=True).strip(),
    'python': sys.version,
    'native_cpu': platform.machine(),
    'checks': [],
}
runs = json.loads(evidence_path.read_text()) if evidence_path.exists() else []
runs.append(run)
def save():
    evidence_path.write_text(json.dumps(runs, indent=2) + '\n')
save()
for close_method in ['Quit button', 'red macOS window close control']:
    print(f'\nWhen the baseline window appears, close it using the {close_method}.', flush=True)
    command = [sys.executable, str(project / 'tools/run_baseline.py'), '--role', 'client']
    result = subprocess.run(command, cwd=project, text=True, capture_output=True)
    check = {
        'requested_close_method': close_method,
        'command': command,
        'working_directory': str(project),
        'exit_status': result.returncode,
        'stdout': result.stdout,
        'stderr': result.stderr,
    }
    run['checks'].append(check)
    save()
    print(result.stdout, end='', flush=True)
    print(result.stderr, end='', file=sys.stderr, flush=True)
    if result.returncode != 0 or 'Baseline client exited with status 0.' not in result.stdout:
        print(f'Check failed; results saved to {evidence_path}', flush=True)
        sys.exit(1)
run['finished_at'] = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
save()
print(f'\nBoth close checks returned 0. Results: {evidence_path}')
print(f'Disposable test project retained at {project}; your original cache is unchanged.')
